title: Building a UV texture from photos

queue.claim: Waechter, Moehrle & Goesele (ECCV 2014) texture method: per-face view selection by graph-cut MRF with a data term of image-gradient magnitude integrated over the projected face, photo-consistency outlier rejection, global colour adjustment (per-vertex additive correction by least squares along seams), and local Poisson editing on a seam strip of about 20 px. This is the basis for the engine's 'select_poisson' blend mode.
queue.query: Waechter Moehrle Goesele "Let There Be Color" large-scale texturing global color adjustment local Poisson editing gradient magnitude data term

queue.claim: Blender (current 4.x/5.x): Cycles bake has a 16 px default margin and margin types 'Adjacent Faces' and 'Extend'. The UV Project modifier projects through a camera with aspect settings. Texture Paint has Image > Apply Camera Image (paint.project_image). These underpin the pure-Blender projection route.
queue.query: Blender manual bake margin type Adjacent Faces Extend UV Project modifier Apply Camera Image
